prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Columbus OH?
answer_verbatim:
Do you mean spray (airbrush) tan or UV (tanning bed) — and where in Columbus (ZIP or neighborhood)? I can pull current ratings/hours/prices and give a short list of the best nearby salons, but the “best” depends on which method you want, how close you need it to be, and your budget.

Quick guidance until you tell me location and preference:
- If you want a safer, natural-looking result, choose a professional spray/airbrush tan from a studio with certified techs and before/after photos.
- For UV tanning, look for a salon with well-maintained, modern beds, good ventilation, clear hygiene policies, and staff who will assess your skin type.
- Check Google/Yelp for recent reviews, photos, and a 4+ star average. Call to confirm first-time packages and whether the tech is certified (for spray tans).

If you tell me your neighborhood or ZIP and whether you want spray or UV, I’ll pull the current top 3–5 options in Columbus with ratings, pros/cons, and links.
